info.title: Versioned API with Deprecations
info.description: A well-versioned API demonstrating versioning strategy documentation, deprecation notices, and migration guidance. Version 2.1.0 introduces new endpoints while deprecating legacy ones. Breaking changes from v1: the /legacy endpoint now returns a different schema. For backward compatibility, the old schema is still available via Accept header versioning. Migration guide: see https://example.com/migrate-v1-to-v2 for upgrade instructions.
